
Terminal and Console Class Library for .NET
Copyright (c) 2007-2009 David Pinch * http://www.thoughtproject.com/Libraries/Terminals/

Overview

    This class library provides a richer console experience than the standard
    System.Console class.  It supports embedded macros, ANSI, terminal protocols,
    and a rich API for manipulating colors.


Status

    The code is currently in an early stage of development and is not yet complete.
    The ultimate goal is to create a virtual buffering system that will allow complete
    control over the console or remote terminal but this is still in the future.
    In the meantime the library has sufficient functionality to be used in simple
    text-oriented applications.

    Be sure to go through the tutorial in the Samples folder.

History

    Version 0.1.1  Solution format upgraded to 2008
    Version 0.1    Initial version
